```{r, echo=TRUE}

## ==========================================================
## TFCE for between-subject 2 x 2 factorial design in R
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction
##
## Tests:
##   3. A x B interaction
##
## Permutation:
##   Freedman-Lane
## ==========================================================


rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(fields)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read_csv("../data/04_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read_csv("../data/04_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject     = factor(Subject),
    Channel     = factor(Channel),
    FactorA     = as.numeric(FactorA),
    FactorB     = as.numeric(FactorB),
    Interaction = as.numeric(Interaction)
  )

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function: compute t-map for one effect
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap_2x2 <- function(data, effect_name) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    summarise(t_value = coef(summary(
      lm(Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction)
    ))[effect_name, "t value"], .groups = "drop")
  
  tvec <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time    = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_value)
  
  matrix(
    tvec,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_ObsInt <- compute_tmap_2x2(dat, "Interaction")

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_ObsInt <- tfce_transform(t_ObsInt, E  = 0.66, H  = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ========================================================
## Step 3: Freedman-Lane permutation
## ========================================================

set.seed(123)

nPerm <- 999
TFCE_permMaxInt <- rep(NA_real_, nPerm)

cat("Precomputing reduced-model fitted values and residuals...\n")

FL_partsInt <- dat %>%
  group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    df <- .x
    
    lm_red <- lm(Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB, data = df)
    
    df$Y_hat_red <- fitted(lm_red)
    df$resid_red <- residuals(lm_red)
    
    df
  }) %>%
  ungroup()



cat("Starting Freedman-Lane permutation testing...\n")

for (p in seq_len(nPerm)) {
  perm_datInt <- FL_partsInt %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      df <- .x
      
      perm_idx <- sample(seq_len(length(unique(dat$Subject))))
      
      df$Amplitude <- df$Y_hat_red + df$resid_red[perm_idx]
      
      df
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  t_perm_Int <- compute_tmap_2x2(perm_datInt, "Interaction")
  
  TFCE_permInt <- tfce_transform(t_perm_Int,
                                 E  = 0.66,
                                 H  = 2,
                                 dh = 0.1)
  
  TFCE_permMaxInt[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_permInt), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (p %% 50 == 0) {
    cat("Permutation", p, "of", nPerm, "\n")
  }
}

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ========================================================
## TFCE-corrected significance
## ========================================================

cat("Step 5: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

maxTFCEInt <- sort(c(TFCE_permMaxInt, max(abs(TFCE_ObsInt), na.rm = TRUE)))

maxTFCEcritInt <- maxTFCEInt[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

MaskInt <- abs(TFCE_ObsInt) >= maxTFCEcritInt

P_ValuesInt <- matrix(NA,
                      nrow = nChan,
                      ncol = nTime,
                      dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_ObsInt))

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_ValuesInt[ch, t] <-
      (sum(TFCE_permMaxInt >= abs(TFCE_ObsInt[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcritInt))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")
Results <- list(
  Obs_Int        = t_ObsInt,
  TFCE_Obs_Int   = TFCE_ObsInt,
  TFCE_Null_Int    = TFCE_permMaxInt,
  maxTFCEcritInt  = maxTFCEcritInt,
  P_ValuesInt     = P_ValuesInt,
  Mask_Int         = MaskInt,
  alpha        = alpha,
  nPerm        = nPerm,
  model        = "Amplitude ~ FactorA + FactorB + Interaction",
  test         = "Interaction",
  times        = times,
  channels     = channels
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Plot significant corrected t-maps
## ==========================================================

mA <- Results$Obs_Int
mA[!Results$Mask_Int] <- 0
plot_eeg_map(mA, "TFCE-corrected Interaction Effect between A and B", times, nChan)

## ==========================================================
## Plot significant corrected t-maps
## ==========================================================
plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs, "Observed TFCE Map: A x B Interaction", times, nChan)

## ==========================================================
## Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../results")) {
  dir.create("../results")
}

save(Results, file = "../results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData", times, nChan)

cat("\nTFCE 2 x 2 between-subject analysis completed.\n")
cat("Saved results: ../results/03_TFCE_between_subject_2x2_results.RData\n", times, nChan)
```
